title: Midnight Lantern Carousel
description: A horse gallops in a circular path around a central glowing lantern in a nighttime scene. The user controls the horse's animation speed, lantern glow intensity, orbit radius, and can keyframe these parameters over a timeline to create a choreographed animation sequence with full undo/redo support.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load horse.glb and Lantern.glb. Place the lantern at the world origin on a dark ground plane. The horse orbits the lantern in a circular path. Set up a dark nighttime scene with a subtle ambient light (0x112244) and a PointLight parented to the lantern that casts warm light (0xffaa44). Camera starts at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin with OrbitControls enabled.

Implement these interactions: (1) A speed slider (0.1x to 3x) controlling the horse orbit angular velocity and its AnimationMixer playback rate simultaneously (multi-input coupling). (2) A glow slider controlling the lantern PointLight intensity (0.5 to 8) and also scaling the lantern model slightly (1.0 to 1.3) for a breathing effect. (3) A radius slider (2 to 8) controlling the horse orbit distance from center. (4) A timeline bar at the bottom with 10 keyframe slots. Clicking a slot captures the current speed, glow, and radius values as a keyframe. (5) A Play button that interpolates between placed keyframes over time using linear lerp, animating all three parameters. (6) A Clear Keyframe button to remove the selected keyframe. (7) Full undo/redo buttons that track all parameter changes and keyframe additions/removals using a history stack with a maximum of 50 entries. Conservation law: the product of speed multiplied by radius must remain constant at 8.0, so adjusting speed auto-adjusts radius and vice versa, preserving angular momentum. The glow parameter is independent.

The horse should play its embedded animation if available. Add a particle system of small orange sprites drifting upward from the lantern to simulate embers. Display current parameter values in a HUD overlay. The ground plane should receive shadows from the horse cast by the lantern point light. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop. All UI controls should be HTML elements positioned absolutely over the canvas.
